context: Ren and Mei reflect on a documentary about society.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (世の中/性格/実感/依存/根本) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あの番組、世の中の仕組みを描いてたね。
lines.en: That program depicted how society works.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、技術への依存が、テーマだったね。
lines.en: Yeah, dependence on technology was the theme.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 便利さに、すっかり依存してるよね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 根本から、考え直す必要があるね。
lines.en: We need to rethink it from the root.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 人の性格も、変わってきた気がする。
lines.en: I feel people's character has changed too.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 見て初めて、実感が湧いたよ。
lines.en: Only after watching did it feel real.
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 世の中を、自分の目で見たいね。
lines.en: I want to see society with my own eyes.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 根本の問いを、忘れないようにね。
lines.en: Let's not forget the fundamental question.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
